# 86th Drama League Awards

| venue =
}}
The 86th Drama League Awards were announced on June 18, 2020, recognizing excellence in theatre productions during the 2019–20 season, which was cut short due to the COVID-19 pandemic, five new categories were created for this year's ceremony only, reflecting the restrictions on live performance. Nominations were announced on April 30, 2020, and winners were announced on June 18, 2020, virtually.
Winners and nominees
Nominations for the 2019–2020 Drama League Awards were announced in a virtual ceremony on April 30, 2020. The year's awards were announced to be the Gratitude Awards for this season, due to the closure of theatre due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Nonetheless, award winners were announced virtually on June 18, 2020, with the notable absence of direction awards.
The Inheritance won the award for Outstanding Production of a Play, Moulin Rouge! The Musical won Outstanding Production of a Musical, and ''A Soldier's Play and Little Shop of Horrors took home the awards for revival of a play and musical, respectively. Danny Burstein won the award for Distinguished Performance for his role as Harold Zidler in Moulin Rouge! The Musical.
